plan.title: fix(security): projectRoot containment for triage welcome atomicWrite (parent-as-root xbrief symlink)

narratives.Description: atomicWrite in packages/core/src/triage/welcome/writers.ts uses containedWrite with root dirname(path) (parent-as-root). A committed or force-added xbrief directory symlink pointing outside the checkout escapes containment. writeTriageScope, writeWipCap, and writeWipCapDecision used by triage:welcome --onboard can create or overwrite outside PROJECT-DEFINITION JSON under the operator identity. Same residual class as #3042 / #2951 / #2980.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

**Medium** residual symlink / parent-as-root containment gap in triage welcome PROJECT-DEFINITION writers (same failure class as #3042 / #2951 / #2980).

`atomicWrite` in `packages/core/src/triage/welcome/writers.ts` calls `containedWrite` with **`root: dirname(path)`** (parent-as-root). A committed or force-added `xbrief/` **directory symlink** that points outside the checkout is therefore **outside** the containment root. Routine onboarding/policy writers can create/overwrite outside `PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` under the operator/automation identity.

## Finding

### Medium — `packages/core/src/triage/welcome/writers.ts` (`atomicWrite`)

**Issue:** `atomicWrite` uses `containedWrite({ root: dirname(path) })` (parent-as-root), so a committed `xbrief/` directory symlink escapes project containment on PROJECT-DEFINITION updates.

Relevant code (scanned at `004004dcaabf14ea442d096dc4387a87c80c1ebf`):

```ts
function atomicWrite(_projectRoot: string, path: string, data: Record<string, unknown>): void {
  const dir = dirname(path);
  // ...
  containedWrite({
    root: resolve(dir),  // parent-as-root — NOT projectRoot
    target: tmpName,
    data: payload,
    mode: "create",
  });
  renameSync(tmp, path);
}
```

Note `_projectRoot` is already threaded into the helper but **unused** for containment — strong signal this is an incomplete #2980 wave D migration of this sink.

**Call sites that reach the sink:**

- `writeTriageScope`
- `writeWipCap` / `writeWipCapDecision`
- Paths exercised by `task triage:welcome -- --onboard` and triage:scope preset paths

## Attack / abuse sketch

| Element | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| **Attacker / input** | Untrusted-repo author; trackable `xbrief` → outside dir with a parseable `PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` (plus `.xbrief.json` so layout accepts) |
| **Path** | Victim runs `task triage:welcome -- --onboard` (or triage:scope preset paths that call `writeTriageScope` / `writeWipCap` / `writeWipCapDecision`) |
| **Mechanism** | Writers resolve the definition under the followed `xbrief` link, then temp+rename via parent-as-root containment that **realpaths to the outside tree** |
| **Impact** | Routine onboarding/policy writers can **create/overwrite outside PROJECT-DEFINITION JSON** under the operator/automation identity |

v1 threat model: same class as #2951 — do not treat “trusted operator” as sufficient; local agent/tooling path is the product surface. Untrusted-repo authors can plant lifecycle layout that diverts writes when the victim runs normal onboarding verbs.

## Remediation

1. Contain against **`projectRoot`** (`assertWriteTargetSafe` / `containedWrite` with `root=projectRoot`).
2. **Refuse** escaping `xbrief` parents (symlink lifecycle parents fail closed).
3. Prefer shared `atomicWriteProjectDefinition` **only after** that helper is fixed the same way (do not consolidate into a still-broken shared sink).
4. Use the already-present `projectRoot` argument (drop the `_` discard) so the containment root cannot drift from callers.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `atomicWrite` (and any `atomicWriteProjectDefinition` helper used here) contains against **projectRoot**, not `dirname(path)`
- [ ] Escaping / symlink `xbrief/` parents refused before temp write + rename
- [ ] `writeTriageScope` / `writeWipCap` / `writeWipCapDecision` / `triage:welcome --onboard` fail closed when `xbrief` is a dir symlink outside the checkout (no outside write)
- [ ] Regression test: force-added or fixture `xbrief` → outside + parseable PROJECT-DEFINITION does not write outside JSON
- [ ] Inventory / `verify:contained-writes` (or equivalent) does not re-list this sink as an open product hole
- [ ] CHANGELOG cites this issue

## Non-goals

- Full monorepo nested-root redesign
- Changing triage/welcome **semantics** beyond containment
- Reopening #2951 epic scope beyond this residual sink

## Related

| Ref | Role |
|-----|------|
| #3042 | Same parent-as-root class (atomicWriteText, ritual-state, probe-session) — closed residual batch |
| #2951 | Epic: mandatory contained-write API |
| #2980 | Residual TS product sink migration (wave D comment already on this sink) |
| `packages/core/src/fs/contained-write.ts` | Canonical API |
| `packages/core/src/fs/projection-containment.ts` | `assertWriteTargetSafe` |

## Source

AppSec residual — Medium finding on `packages/core/src/triage/welcome/writers.ts`.

**Commit scanned:** `004004dcaabf14ea442d096dc4387a87c80c1ebf`

Do not consolidate into a still-broken shared atomicWriteProjectDefinition until that helper is fixed the same way.
